title: PRISM: Festina Lente Proactivity -- Risk-Sensitive, Uncertainty-Aware Deliberation for Proactive Agents
abstract: arXiv:2602.01532v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Proactive agents must decide not only what to say but also whether and when to intervene. Many current systems rely on brittle heuristics or indiscriminate long reasoning, which offers little control over the benefit-burden tradeoff. We formulate the problem as cost-sensitive selective intervention and present PRISM, a novel framework that couples a decision-theoretic gate with a dual-process reasoning architecture. At inference time, the agent intervenes only when a calibrated probability of user acceptance exceeds a threshold derived from asymmetric costs of missed help and false alarms. Inspired by festina lente (Latin: "make haste slowly"), we gate by an acceptance-calibrated, cost-derived threshold and invoke a resource-intensive Slow mode with counterfactual checks only near the decision boundary, concentrating computation on ambiguous and high-stakes cases. translated_title: PRISM：从容不迫的主动性——面向主动智能体的风险敏感、不确定性感知的审慎决策
translated_abstract: 主动智能体不仅需要决定说什么，还需要决定是否以及何时进行干预。当前许多系统依赖脆弱的启发式规则或不加区分的长篇推理，这对收益与负担之间的权衡几乎没有控制能力。我们将该问题形式化为代价敏感的选择性干预，并提出了PRISM——一个将决策理论门控与双过程推理架构相结合的新型框架。在推理时，只有当经过校准的用户接受概率超过一个由“错失帮助”与“误报”的不对称代价所导出的阈值时，智能体才会进行干预。受拉丁语格言festina lente（意为“欲速则不达”）的启发，我们通过接受度校准、代价导出的阈值进行门控，并且仅在接近决策边界时才调用带有反事实检查的资源密集型慢速模式，从而将计算集中于模糊不清和高风险的案例。训练采用门控对齐、模式锁定的蒸馏方法：教师模型运行……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: PRISM通过决策理论门控与双过程推理架构相结合，让主动智能体仅在校准后的用户接受概率超过由不对称代价导出的阈值时才进行干预，并只在决策边界附近才调用耗资源的慢速推理，从而有效控制干预的收益与负担权衡。
en_tdlr: PRISM couples a decision-theoretic gate with a dual-process reasoning architecture, enabling proactive agents to intervene only when a calibrated user-acceptance probability exceeds a cost-derived threshold while invoking resource-intensive slow deliberation only near the decision boundary, thereby balancing the benefit-burden tradeoff of interventions.
